items.title: PentAGI AI-Powered Penetration Testing Tool with Nmap, Metasploit, and Report Generation
items.description: PentAGI introduces a groundbreaking AI-driven approach to penetration testing, automating complex workflows with tools like Nmap and Metasploit while generating detailed reports. Developed by VXControl and released on GitHub in early 2025, this open-source platform empowers security professionals to conduct autonomous assessments in isolated Docker environments. items.title: Google Issues Emergency Chrome Security Update to Address High-Severity PDFium and V8 Flaws
items.description: A significant security update for the Chrome Stable Channel to address multiple vulnerabilities, including high-severity flaws affecting the browser’s core engines. The tech giant announced the rollout of versions 145.0.7632.109/110 for Windows and Mac, as well as 144.0.7559.109 for Linux. This update is currently being distributed to the global user base. items.title: Three Former Google Engineers Indicted Over Trade Secret Transfers to Iran
items.description: Two former Google engineers and one of their husbands have been indicted in the U.S. for allegedly committing trade secret theft from the search giant and other tech firms and transferring the information to unauthorized locations, including Iran. items.title: Splunk Enterprise for Windows Vulnerability Let Attackers Hijack DLLs and Gain SYSTEM Access
items.description: Splunk has disclosed a high-severity vulnerability in Splunk Enterprise for Windows that allows a low-privileged local user to escalate their privileges to SYSTEM level through a DLL search-order hijacking attack. items.title: ZDI-CAN-28762: Flowise
items.description: A CVSS score 8.1 AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Nicholas Zubrisky (@NZubrisky) of TrendAI Research' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-02-19, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-06-19 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
